name: What is the difference between repairing and replacing a septic tank?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between repairing and replacing a septic tank?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing a septic tank usually addresses isolated issues like a broken baffle, minor leak, or clogged pipe within the existing system. Replacement, on the other hand, involves removing the old tank and/or drain field and installing a completely new system. The decision between repair and replacement depends on the extent of the damage, the age of the system, and its overall functionality. A comprehensive inspection by CG Plumbing Solutions can determine if a repair is viable or if a full replacement is the more cost-effective and long-term solution for issues like those often seen in older systems in areas like Paradise or Spring Valley.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair fixes isolated issues; replacement installs a new system. The choice depends on damage extent, age, and overall functionality.
